Every expected value is a Test_TimeSeries.cs literal: Test_CalendarYearSeries, Test_WaterYearSeries, Test_CustomYearSeries, Test_MonthlySeries, Test_QuarterlySeries, Test_PeaksOverThreshold, Test_PeaksOverThreshold_MovingSum_NaN and Test_CalendarYearSeries_NaN.
reference: A block series is irregular: each ordinate carries the date of the observation the block function selected (the extremum's own date for minimum/maximum, the last ordinate's for sum/average), so an even index selects that date and the odd index beside it the value. `missing_indexes` marks ordinates as missing by position, since JSON has no NaN literal.

assertions.source: Test_CalendarYearSeries_NaN: the strict comparison is false against NaN, so the missing value is never chosen
